research_question: Can topology alone classify universal reconvergence, partial reconvergence, and obstruction across the continuation graphs generated from the bounded Notebook 12 configuration domain?
hypothesis: Within the bounded Notebook 12 domain, graph-topological invariants mediate the sequence local mechanisms -> continuation graph topology -> reconvergence geometry -> J. The null is that topology-only invariants fail to classify geometry better than label-frequency and previously recorded scalar-summary baselines.

independent_variables.name: continuation_graph_topology
independent_variables.definition: Topology-only representation of each regenerated Notebook 12 continuation graph after removing mechanism labels from the classifier feature set.
independent_variables.allowed_values_or_range: One invariant vector per Notebook 12 factorial configuration.

independent_variables.name: topological_invariant_family
independent_variables.definition: Reachability lattice, SCC condensation DAG, basin decomposition, articulation hierarchy, irreversible separation depth, merge depth, partial-order width, dominance tree, and closure lattice.

dependent_variables.name: geometry_class
dependent_variables.definition: Notebook 12 reconvergence geometry label: universal_reconvergence, partial_reconvergence, or obstruction.

controls.name: label_frequency_baseline
controls.purpose: Detect whether topology-only classification exceeds the majority-class or empirical-frequency baseline.
controls.implementation: Compare topology-only metrics to stratified dummy classifiers.

controls.name: mechanism_label_exclusion
controls.purpose: Prevent mechanism identity from leaking into the topology-only test.
controls.implementation: Exclude mask_bits, mechanism booleans, and active_mechanism_count from classifier features.

controls.name: graph_size_control
controls.purpose: Detect whether classification is only graph-size proxying rather than invariant structure.
controls.implementation: Compare full invariant model against node_count/edge_count/depth-only baselines.

controls.name: config_group_split
controls.purpose: Reduce leakage from repeated parameter panels and seed variants.
controls.implementation: Evaluate grouped splits by mask_bits and parameter panel where feasible.

random_seed.seed_scope: train/test splits, randomized classifier baselines, and any randomized dimensionality checks
random_seed.derivation_policy: Fixed before execution; derived seeds must be deterministic functions of 130013 and recorded in output manifests.

parameter_space.name: topology_feature_sets
parameter_space.values_or_range: individual invariant family, all families, all minus graph-size controls, and graph-size-only baseline

termination_conditions: All Notebook 12 configurations are processed or each skipped configuration has a recoverable skip reason.
Invariant tables, classifier reports, counterexample tables, and manifest are written.
No post-hoc invariant family is added without superseding this specification.

expected_outputs.name: topological_invariant_table
expected_outputs.interpretation_role: Primary topology-only invariant table joined to Notebook 12 geometry/J labels.

expected_outputs.name: classification_report
expected_outputs.interpretation_role: Reports whether topology-only features classify geometry above controls inside the bounded domain.

expected_outputs.name: counterexample_catalog
expected_outputs.interpretation_role: Preserves failures, ambiguous topology signatures, and topology-equivalent graphs with different labels or J values.

expected_outputs.name: output_manifest
expected_outputs.interpretation_role: Binds inputs, outputs, hashes, seed, and claim ceiling.

decision_rules: SUCCESS_C2_CANDIDATE: topology-only invariant families classify geometry with materially better performance than label-frequency and graph-size-only controls under held-out grouped evaluation, and counterexamples are bounded and cataloged.
PARTIAL_C2_CANDIDATE: topology separates obstruction from non-obstruction or predicts J strata but fails full three-class classification.
FAILURE_OR_LIMITATION_C2_CANDIDATE: topology-equivalent or near-equivalent signatures produce different geometry/J labels, or performance collapses under grouped controls.
INCONCLUSIVE: graph regeneration, feature extraction, or dependency constraints prevent complete evaluation.
allowed_interpretations: Bounded Notebook 12 domain observation about topology-only classification.
Candidate evidence for or against an implementation-independent continuation-geometry object inside the enumerated domain.
Negative or limitation evidence if topology fails or admits counterexamples.
blocked_interpretations: Claim that topology universally governs reconvergence outside the Notebook 12 domain.
Claim that Notebook 13 validates external physical systems.
Claim promotion above C2 without approved-tool replication and independent measurements.
Post-hoc mechanism identification using excluded mechanism labels.

immutability.supersession_policy: Do not edit after execution starts; create a new spec_id and link the superseding specification.
